Cedar Wheelbarrow Planter Plans

Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:43
Instaread

Cedar wheelbarrow planter plans, DIY fence board project, includes free PDF download (link at bottom of post), shopping list, cutting list, measurements, and drawings.

Material List | Cedar Wheelbarrow Planter Plans

Cutting List

Shopping List

Overview | Cedar Wheelbarrow Planter Plans

Cut two boards to 16 inches for the sides (A).

Cut a 45-degree angle cut on one end as shown on drawing.

Cut two boards to 6 3/4 inches for the front and back (B).

Install as shown on drawing using exterior wood glue and 1 inch finish nails.

Cut one board to 2 1/4 in. x 6 3/4 in. for the back (C).

Cut a 45-degree bevel cut on the top edge.

Install as shown on drawing using exterior wood glue and 1 inch finish nails.

Cut one board to 6 3/4 inches for the bottom (D)

Assemble as shown on drawing using exterior wood glue and 1 inch finish nails.

Cut one board to 3 7/8 in. x 6 3/4 in. for the bottom (E).

Install as shown on drawing using exterior wood glue and 1 inch finish nails.

Cut two boards to 1 3/4 in. x 21 in. for the handles (F).

Drill the hole for the dowel and cut handle as shown on drawing.

Install as shown on drawing using exterior wood glue and 1 inch finish nails.

Cut two boards to 4 1/2 in. circles for the wheels (G).

Install wheels (G) using a 3/4 in. dowel 9 1/4 in. long, as shown on drawing.

Pre drill hole and screw 1 1/4 in. deck screws into the dowel.

Drill 1/4 in. holes and insert 1/4 in. dowels to keep wheels in place, add exterior wood glue.

Cut two boards to 1 in. x 4 3/4 in. for the legs (H).

Install as shown on drawing using exterior wood glue and 1 inch finish nails.

Sand and stain (optional).
